BENGALURU, WEDNESDAY, 21, FEBRUARY, 2024(PHALGUNA, 02, SHAKAVARSHA, 1945) Volume - 159 Issue 40

GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA
RC-CFS0ADMN/161/2024-RC Karnataka Government Secretariat
E- 1301378 Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru 560-001, Date: 03-02-2024

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand under land
revenue in the village and other head of the account and having regard to the
administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose s to issue a
Notification to alter the limits of SOMASAMUDRA Village of KURUGODU Taluk,
BALLARI District and to constitute a new revenue villages called MADIRE as
specified in schedule along with maps with old survey numbers and new assigned
to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Ballari District.

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village of of BALLARI District KURUGODU Taluk to form a new revenue village
called MADIRE Village of KURUGODUTaluk, BALLARI District along with the
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No RD 32 GLH 2023 Dated 13/02/2023
regarding altering the limits of Bandri Village of Sandur Taluk and Ballari District and
Constituting a New Revenue Village called G.Kodihalli was published as required by
section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in
the Karnataka Gazette Dated 04/03/2023 Part no 4A page no 4319 to 4336 inviting
objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty
days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy
Commissioner Ballari district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 11/10/2023 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the
areas specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the
said village Bandri Village of Sandur Taluk in Ballari District to Form a New Revenue
Village called as G.Kodihalli of Sandur Taluk Ballari District along with the Survey
Numbers included in column(4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the
factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand under land
revenue in the village and other head of the account and having regard to the
administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a
Notification to alter the limits of Chintaki Village of Aurad(B) taluk Bidar
District and to constitute a new revenue villages called Chintaki Tanda as
specified in schedule.
Notification is hereby issued that Land bearing survey numbers and extent
specified in Schedule shall be declared as habitation area within the boundary of
Chintaki village for conversion of Chintaki Tanda unrecorded habitation in to hamlet
of the said revenue village.

Now , therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said
Act, notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be
affected thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after

thirty days from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Bidar District.

SCHEDULE
Land bearing survey numbers and extent specified below in column (3) of the
table shall be declared as habitation area of called Chintaki village of Auarad (B)
taluk of Bidar District convert the same to form hamlet/extension within the boundary
of Chintaki Tanda Revenue village and same will here in after be named as called
Chintaki Tanda of Chintaki village in Auarad (B) taluk of Bidar District.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand under land
revenue in the village and other head of the account and having regard to the
administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose s to issue a
Notification to alter the limits of Gangnbeed village of Kamalnagar Taluk, Bidar
District and to constitute a new revenue villages called Gangnbeed Tanda as
specified in schedule along with maps with old survey numbers and new assigned
to them.

notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Bidar District.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No RD 945 Kamgrara 2017 Dated:22-12-
2017 regarding altering the limits of Hemdore village of Sira Taluk and Tumkur
District and constituting a new revenue villages called Veerapura,
kereyagalachikkenahalli, Gollarahalli, Gundapanachikkenahalli and
Veeraganahalli was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette RD 945 Kamgrara
2017 Dated:08-02-2018 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to
be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Tumkur district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:13-02-2018 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Hemdore of Sira taluk in Tumkur District to form a new revenue village called
as veerapura of Sira taluk Tumkur District along with the survey numbers included
in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand under land
revenue in the village and other head of the account and having regard to the
administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose s to issue a
Notification to alter the limits of Kotagudda Village of Pavagada Taluk, Tumkur
District and to constitute a new revenue village called Arekyatanahalli as
specified in schedule along with maps with old survey numbers and new assigned
to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Tumkur District.

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village of Tumkur District Pavagada Taluk to form a new revenue village called
Arekyatanahalli Village of Pavagada Taluk, Tumkur District along with the survey
numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No No RD 31 PFH 2023, Dated:13-03-2023
regarding altering the limits of Tallur village of Yaragatti Taluk and Belagavi District
and constituting a new revenue village called Somapur was was published as required
by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964)
in the Karnataka Gazette No: 437 Part IV-A dated 17-03-2023 inviting objections or
suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the
date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner
Belagavi district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 17-03-2023 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village of Yaragatti Taluk and Belagavi District to form a new village called Somapur

of Saudatthi Taluk and Belagavi District. The new survey numbers which will form part
of this new village are as specified in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand under land
revenue in the village and other head of the account and having regard to the
administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose s to issue a
Notification to alter the limits of B. BELAGALLU Village of BALLARI Taluk,
BALLARIDistrict and to constitute a new revenue villages called B.
BELAGALLU THANDA as specified in schedule along with maps with old
survey numbers and new assigned to them.
Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date

Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Ballari District.

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village of B. BELAGALLU Village of BALLARI Taluk, BALLARIdistrict to form a
new revenue village called B. BELAGALLU THANDA Village of BALLARI Taluk,
BALLARIDistrict along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No RD 945 Kamgrara 2017 Dated:22-12-
2017 regarding altering the limits of Shibi agrahara village of Sira Taluk and Tumkur
District and constituting a new revenue villages called Amalagondi ,Ajjaiahnapalya
,Hanumantha Nagara, Nagenahalli, Luttahanumaiahnapalya and Jogihalli was
published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka
act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 1044 Kamgrara Dated:22-01-
2018 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby
within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner Tumkur district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 05-04-2018 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;

Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Shibi Agrahara of Sira taluk in Tumkur District to form a new revenue village
called as Amalagondi of Sira taluk Tumkur District along with the survey numbers
included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No No. RD 937 Kamgrara 2017 Dated:22-
12-2017 regarding altering the limits of Naduru village of Sira Taluk and Tumkur
District and constituting a new revenue village called Neralahalli, Kereyagalahalli,
Sigalahalli and Uddaramanahalli was published as required by section 6 of the
Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka
Gazette RD 937 Kamgrara 2017 Dated:08-02-2018 inviting objections or suggestions
from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its

publication in the Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Tumkur
district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:13-02-2018 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Naduru of Sira Taluk and Tumkur District to form a new revenue village
called as Neralahalli of Sira Taluk in Tumkur District along with the survey
numbers included in column (4) thereof.

TABLE-1
Extent of area Survey numbers Specified
